families.visualIdentity: Six-legged stone-and-copper scavenger with luminous teeth worn flat by gate masonry.
families.coreBehavior: Bites braces, pulls at formation edges, and flees from sustained light.

families.visualIdentity: Lean pack beast with iron-red plates, scent vents, and a worker’s rope still caught around one foreleg.
families.coreBehavior: Marks wounded targets, circles exposed rear positions, and retreats when isolated.

families.visualIdentity: Empty maintenance armor animated by loose XP dust and fragments of old work orders.
families.coreBehavior: Steals dropped resources, braces under pressure, and repeats the last command it heard.

families.visualIdentity: Flock of translucent insects that flash gate-blue patterns between knife-like wings.
families.coreBehavior: Signals allied Unions, peppers rear slots, and disperses when struck by broad fields.

families.visualIdentity: Mixed-race opportunists wearing altered civic vests and fraudulent charter badges.
families.coreBehavior: Demands surrender, targets supplies, and withdraws if its leader is exposed.

families.visualIdentity: Luminous fungus walking on root-like cords, growing along warm dimensional fractures.
families.coreBehavior: Creates hazardous fields, drains MP, and anchors itself near anomalies.

families.visualIdentity: A maintenance-lifter construct with one arm rebuilt into a massive gate-hinge hammer.
families.coreBehavior: Telegraphs line-breaking blows and protects smaller constructs behind its frame.

families.visualIdentity: A stretched shadow-creature that occupies the delay between a sound and its echo.
families.coreBehavior: Copies recent movement, attacks isolated members, and vanishes after failed strikes.

families.visualIdentity: Old rustback hound with a brass jaw brace, tracking ribbons, and disciplined scars.
families.coreBehavior: Coordinates pack marks, protects wounded beasts, and calls a withdrawal before annihilation.

families.visualIdentity: Tripod maintenance scribe inscribing luminous timing marks across walls and allies.
families.coreBehavior: Accelerates allied MP recovery, reads visible telegraphs, and withdraws behind front lines.

families.visualIdentity: Humanoid in layered salvage chains, each link engraved with a different fraudulent claim.
families.coreBehavior: Pulls targets out of formation, locks routes, and spends AP to maintain control.

families.visualIdentity: Former relief automaton coated in soot, still following an obsolete triage hierarchy.
families.coreBehavior: Heals the highest-authority ally first, cleanses structural statuses, and refuses low-priority civilians.

families.visualIdentity: Massive burrowing creature armored in stolen gate hinges and bridge pins.
families.coreBehavior: Consumes cover, creates collapsed routes, and exposes a softer underside after charging.

families.displayName: Captain Ravel of the Broken Charter
families.visualIdentity: Charismatic salvage captain in immaculate stolen guild colors, leading people who still believe his promises.
families.coreBehavior: Uses hostages and false retreats, protects his crew, and may surrender if his fraud is publicly proven.

families.visualIdentity: Ancient gate-maintenance commander built from basalt plates, brass ribs, and a blue core that displays obsolete civic law.
families.coreBehavior: Treats relief construction as unauthorized obstruction, commands resonance pylons, and telegraphs system-wide reset orders.

enemies.displayName: Captain Ravel of the Broken Charter
